C0798.title: Microsoft Exposes Storm-2949 Using Stolen Credentials for Large-Scale Cloud Resource Theft
C0798.summary: In May 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence disclosed that Storm-2949 used social engineering and SSPR abuse to take over Entra ID identities, then used legitimate Azure management features to access Microsoft 365, file-hosting services, and Azure production environments. Microsoft described data exfiltration and lateral movement across cloud control-plane and data-plane resources.
